name: Invoice Ninja
description: Invoice Ninja: clients, invoices, quotes, recurring invoices, payments, products, expenses and projects. REST API v5 on Invoice Ninja's hosted service or your own instance, API-token auth.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Sign in and open **Settings → Account Management → API Tokens** (on v5; on a self-hosted instance the same page exists).
2. Create a token and put it in `INVOICENINJA_API_TOKEN`.
3. Set `INVOICENINJA_URL`. For the hosted service that is `https://invoicing.co`; for a self-hosted instance, your own root. No trailing slash and no `/api/v1` — the adapter appends it.

**The header is `X-API-TOKEN`.**

**One token, one company.** Invoice Ninja supports several companies per account, and the token is bound to the one it was created in. A second company needs a second token and a second connector.

**`include` resolves relationships in one call**: `include=client,invitations` on an invoice, `include=contacts` on a client. Without it you get ids and have to fetch each one.

**Status is a small integer, and each document type numbers it differently.** For invoices: 1 draft, 2 sent, 3 partial, 4 paid, 5 cancelled, -1 reversed. For quotes: 1 draft, 2 sent, 3 approved, 4 converted, 5 expired. Do not assume they line up.

**Amounts are floats in the client's currency**, and `balance` is what is still owed while `amount` is the invoice total. A receivables figure wants `balance`.

**Soft deletes are hidden by default.** Archived and deleted records are excluded unless you ask for them, which is usually right — but it is why a record somebody swears exists can be missing.

**Self-hosted, which is the thing to plan for.**
- On **AnythingMCP Cloud** the instance must be reachable from the public internet on a real hostname with a valid TLS certificate. A self-signed certificate will fail: the connector offers no trust-anything switch.
- On an internal host (`invoices.intern`, `10.0.0.x`), self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and add that host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or the outbound guard refuses the call before it is made.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_clients
tools.description: List clients with their name, contacts, balance, paid-to-date total and currency. The quickest call for checking that the API token works.

filter.description: Search fragment matched against name, e-mail and number.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. contacts.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_get_client
tools.description: Read one client in full: their contacts, addresses, payment terms, balance and the settings that override the company defaults for them.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. contacts,documents.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their number, date, due date, client, amount and balance. Status 1 draft, 2 sent, 3 partial, 4 paid, 5 cancelled.

filter.description: Search fragment matched against number and PO number.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. client.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice in full: every line item with quantity, cost and tax, the totals, the balance outstanding and the payments applied.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. client,payments.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes with their number, date, client, amount and status — what is out with prospects and not yet converted into an invoice.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. client.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_payments
tools.description: List payments with their date, amount, method, client and the invoices they were applied to — the money that actually arrived.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. client,invoices.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_recurring_invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoices with their frequency, next send date, client and amount — the predictable part of the revenue.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. client.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_products
tools.description: List products with their key, notes, cost, price, quantity and tax settings.

filter.description: Search fragment matched against the product key and notes.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses with their date, vendor, category, amount and whether they have been billed to a client — the cost side of the ledger.

client_id.description: Restrict to expenses billed to one client.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, e.g. client,vendor.

tools.name: invoice_ninja_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their name, client, budgeted hours, task rate and due date — the anchor for time and profitability questions.
